speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for National Development what are the anticipated changes in timeline and planning for the Jurong Lake District should there be major delays, route alterations or cancellation of the High-Speed Rail project.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: And as I mentioned during the Sitting on 9 July 2018, the plans for the Jurong Lake District were formulated in 2008, well before the HSR project came about.
